changelog:
Initial release with multi-account Feishu bot configuration and agent binding.

- Add interactive flow to register new Feishu bot accounts and configure routing (account-level or group-level binding).
- Support command-line setup for both account and group chat bindings.
- Preserve and auto-backup existing Feishu config before updating.
- Automatic session dmScope configuration and gateway restart after changes.
- Includes restore instructions if issues occur.
summary: 交互式添加并绑定新的飞书机器人账户，支持账户级或群聊级路由，自动备份配置并重启服务生效。
